import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int rounds = Integer.parseInt(scanner.nextLine().trim());
        int[] alice_moves = Arrays.stream(scanner.nextLine().split(" "))
                                  .mapToInt(Integer::parseInt)
                                  .toArray();
        int[] bob_moves = Arrays.stream(scanner.nextLine().split(" "))
                                .mapToInt(Integer::parseInt)
                                .toArray();

        int[] bob_moves_rotated = new int[rounds];
        for (int i = 0; i < rounds; i++) {
            bob_moves_rotated[i] = bob_moves[(i + 1) % rounds];
        }

        int min_win = 0;
        int max_win = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < rounds; i++) {
            min_win += Math.min(alice_moves[i], bob_moves_rotated[i]);
        }

        int max_bob = Arrays.stream(bob_moves_rotated).max().getAsInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < rounds; i++) {
            if (bob_moves_rotated[i] == max_bob && bob_moves_rotated[i] + alice_moves[i] > min_win) {
                min_win = bob_moves_rotated[i] + alice_moves[i];
            }
        }

        int max_alice = Arrays.stream(alice_moves).max().getAsInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < rounds; i++) {
            if (alice_moves[i] == max_alice && alice_moves[i] + bob_moves_rotated[i] > min_win) {
                min_win = alice_moves[i] + bob_moves_rotated[i];
            }
        }

        if (min_win > rounds) {
            min_win -= rounds;
        } else {
            min_win = 0;
        }

        System.out.println(min_win + " " + max_win);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
